<effect id="com.alightcreative.effects.fractalwarp" compat="acScreenNorm-y" name="@string/name" desc="@string/desc" category="distort" deprecated="true">

    <strings>
        <locale lang="en">
            <string name="name">Fractal Warp</string>
            <string name="desc">Fractal Warp shader</string>
        </locale>
    </strings>

    <params>
        <texture id="inputImg" srcType="content" />
        <slider id="GAIN" default="0.452" min="0.01" max=".99" label="Gain" />
        <slider id="LACUNARITY" default="4.012" min="0.1" max="10.0" label="Lacunarity" />
        <slider id="AMP" default="-0.5" min="-2.0" max="2.0" label="Amplitude" />
        <slider id="SPEED" default="1.0" min="0.25" max="10.0" label="Speed" />
        <slider id="FREQ" default="1.352" min="0.5" max="2.0" label="Zoom" />
        <slider id="LUMA" default="1.172" min="0.5" max="2.0" label="Luma" />
    </params>

    <shader type="fragment" precision="high"><![CDATA[

        float random (in vec2 st) {
            return fract(sin(dot(st.xy,
                                 vec2(12.9898,78.233)))
                         * 43758.5453123);
        }

        // 2D Noise based on Morgan McGuire @morgan3d
        // https://www.shadertoy.com/view/4dS3Wd
        float noise (vec2 st) {
            vec2 i = floor(st);
            vec2 f = fract(st);

            // Four corners in 2D of a tile
            float a = random(i);
            float b = random(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0));
            float c = random(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0));
            float d = random(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0));

            // Smooth Interpolation

            // Cubic Hermine Curve.  Same as SmoothStep()
            vec2 u = f*f*(3.0-2.0*f);
            // u = smoothstep(0.,1.,f);

            // Mix 4 coorners porcentages
            return mix(a, b, u.x) +
                    (c - a)* u.y * (1.0 - u.x) +
                    (d - b) * u.x * u.y;
        }

        #define OCTAVES 4
        //#define GAIN 0.452
        //#define LACUNARITY 4.012

        float fbm(vec2 st) {
            float luma = LUMA;
            float amplitude = AMP;
            float frequency = FREQ;
            for (int i = 0; i < OCTAVES; i++) {
                luma += amplitude * noise(frequency*st);
                frequency *= LACUNARITY;
                amplitude *= GAIN;
            }
            return luma;
        }


        void main() {

            //vec4 texColor = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,acScreenNorm);
            //if( texColor.a <= 0.0001 )
            //    discard;

            // --- Shader -------------------------------------
            float t = acTime * SPEED;

            vec2 st = ((vec2(acScreenNorm.x,1.0-acScreenNorm.y)*acScreenSize)-acLayerCenter)/acLayerSize;
            st.y*=acLayerSize.y/acLayerSize.x;

            vec2 qq = vec2(st.y * sin(st.x*18.280+t*2.),
                           st.x * sin(st.y*4.+t*1.));
            vec2 vv = vec2(st.y * sin(st.x*18.280+qq.x*2.),
                           st.x * sin(st.y*4.+qq.y*1.));

            qq = vec2(st.y + t*.1,
                           st.x + t*.2);
            vv = vec2(st.x*fbm(qq*2.1),st.y*fbm(qq*3.4));

            //vv = st;
            //highp float aa = fbm(vv*3.1);
            //highp float bb = fbm(vv);
            //highp float cc = fbm(vv*.4);

            gl_FragColor = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,acScreenNorm.xy + vv);

        }

    ]]></shader>

</effect>

        float random (in vec2 st) {

                                 vec2(12.9898,78.233)))*
                43758.5453123);
        }

        // Based on Morgan McGuire @morgan3d
        // https://www.shadertoy.com/view/4dS3Wd
        float noise (vec2 st) {
            vec2 i = floor(st);
            vec2 f = fract(st);

            // Four corners in 2D of a tile
            float a = random(i);
            float b = random(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0));
            float c = random(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0));
            float d = random(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0));

            vec2 u = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);

            return mix(a, b, u.x) +
                    (c - a)* u.y * (1.0 - u.x) +
                    (d - b) * u.x * u.y;
        }

        float fbm (vec2 st, vec2 parallax, int octaveCount, float intens) {
            // Initial values
            float value = 0.;
            float amplitude = 0.5;
            float frequency = 0.;
            //
            // Loop of octaves
            for (int i = 0; i < octaveCount; i++) {
                value += amplitude * noise(st);
                st *= 2.0;
                st += parallax;
                amplitude *= intens;
            }
            return value;
        }


        void main() {

            vec2 st;
            if( screenSpace ) {
                st = acScreenNorm;
                st.x *= acScreenSize.x/acScreenSize.y;
            } else {
                st = acLayerNorm;
                st.x *= acLayerSize.x/acLayerSize.y;
            }

            st += vec2(offsx,offsy);

            vec2 parallax = vec2(parrx, parry);

            float dx = fbm( (st-vec2(0.5,0.5))*3.0*scale+vec2(0.5,0.5), parallax, int(octaves), intensity);
            float dy = fbm( ((st+vec2(25.3,12.9))-vec2(0.5,0.5))*3.0*scale+vec2(0.5,0.5), parallax, int(octaves), intensity);

            vec2 sample;
            if( screenSpace ) {
                sample = acScreenNorm;
            } else {
                sample = acLayerNorm;
            }
            sample = sample + vec2(dx-0.5,dy-0.5) * mag;

            if( !screenSpace ) {
                sample = (vec4(sample,0.0,1.0) * acLayerToScreen).st;
            }

            vec4 texColor = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,sample);

            gl_FragColor = texColor;

            //vec4 rcolor = mix(color1,color2,);
            //rcolor *= texColor.a;
            //gl_FragColor = rcolor + texColor*(1.0-rcolor.a);
        }

    ]]></shader>

<effect id="com.alightcreative.effects.gaussianblur" compat="acScreenNorm-y" name="@am:string/effect_gaussianblur_name" desc="@am:string/effect_gaussianblur_desc" category="blur" tags="blur,essentials,raster" thumb="thumb/gaussianblur.webp" overdraw="true" maxOverdraw="0.1" >
    <params>
        <spinner id="strength" default="0.15" min="0.0" max="2.0" label="@am:string/effect_param_strength" step="0.005" />
        <texture id="inputImg" srcType="content" />
        <texture id="downImg" srcType="buffer" downsample="2" />
        <texture id="hblur" srcType="buffer" downsample="2"/>
        <texture id="vblur" srcType="buffer" downsample="2"/>
    </params>
    <passes>
        <pass target="downImg" />
        <pass target="hblur" />
        <pass target="vblur" />
        <pass />
    </passes>
    <shader type="fragment" precision="high"><![CDATA[

        vec4 blurInternal(AC_ImageInfo image, vec2 texOffset, vec2 st, float numBlurPixelsPerSide)
        {
            if(strength <= 0.0)
                return vec4(0,0,0,0);
            const float PI = 3.14159265;
            //To get gauss(x) <= gauss(0)*0.1
            //x>=sigma*sqrt(2*ln10) = 2.14596602...
            //If you want to get gauss(x) <= gauss(0)*0.01 to get more dedicated result,
            //x>=2.0*sigma*sqrt(ln10) = 3.03485425....
            //currently, in my thought, 0.1 of the center pixel will be enough.
            float adjSigma = numBlurPixelsPerSide / 2.14596602;


            highp vec3 incrementalGaussian;
            incrementalGaussian.x = 1.0 / (sqrt(2.0 * PI) * adjSigma);
            incrementalGaussian.y = exp(-0.5 / (adjSigma * adjSigma));
            incrementalGaussian.z = incrementalGaussian.y * incrementalGaussian.y;

            vec4 avgValue = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
            highp float coefficientSum = 0.0;

            avgValue += (texture2DCv(image.texture,st).rgba * incrementalGaussian.x);
            coefficientSum += incrementalGaussian.x;

            for (float i = 1.0; i <= numBlurPixelsPerSide; i += 2.0) {

                float offset0 = i;
                float offset1 = i + 1.0;

                incrementalGaussian.xy *= incrementalGaussian.yz;
                coefficientSum += (2.0 * incrementalGaussian.x);
                float weight0 = incrementalGaussian.x;
                incrementalGaussian.xy *= incrementalGaussian.yz;
                coefficientSum += (2.0 * incrementalGaussian.x);
                float weight1 = incrementalGaussian.x;
                float weightL = weight0 + weight1;
                float offsetL = (offset0*weight0 + offset1*weight1) / weightL;
                vec2 stL = clamp(st - offsetL * texOffset, vec2(0.0, 0.0), vec2(1.0,1.0));
                vec2 stR = clamp(st + offsetL * texOffset, vec2(0.0, 0.0), vec2(1.0, 1.0));
                avgValue += (texture2DCv(image.texture, stL) * weightL);
                avgValue += (texture2DCv(image.texture, stR) * weightL);
            }

            return avgValue / coefficientSum;
        }
        void main() {
            if( acPass == 0 ) {
                gl_FragColor = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture, acScreenNorm.st);
            }
            else if( acPass==1 ) {
                float kernelSize = strength / 2.0 * 1.14 / 4.0 / 3.0 * length(acPreviewSize);
                vec2 texOffset = vec2(1.0/downImg.size.x, 0.0);
                gl_FragColor = blurInternal(downImg, texOffset, acScreenNorm.st, kernelSize);
            } else if( acPass==2 ) {
                float kernelSize = strength / 2.0 * 1.14 / 4.0 / 3.0 * length(acPreviewSize);
                vec2 texOffset = vec2(0.0, 1.0/hblur.size.y);
                vec4 result = blurInternal(hblur, texOffset, acScreenNorm.st, kernelSize);
                gl_FragColor = strength <= 0.0 ?
                texture2DCv(inputImg.texture, acScreenNorm.st) : result;
            } else {
                gl_FragColor = texture2DCv(vblur.texture, acScreenNorm.st);
            }
        }
    ]]></shader>
</effect>

<effect id="com.alightcreative.effect.glass" compat="acScreenNorm-y" name="@string/name" desc="@string/desc" category="distort" thumb="thumb/glass.webp" deprecated="true">

    <strings>
        <locale lang="en">
            <string name="name">Glass</string>
            <string name="desc">Turns the layer into glass, refracting whatever is behind the layer and adding a glossy shine.</string>
            <string name="radius">Radius</string>
        </locale>
    </strings>

    <params>
        <texture id="inputImg" srcType="content" />
        <texture id="comp" srcType="comp" />
        <texture id="xDistBuf" srcType="buffer" />
        <slider id="radius" default="50.0" min="0.0" max="200.0" label="Radius" logscale="2.5" />
        <slider id="angle_d" default="45.0" min="0.0" max="360.0" label="Diffuse Angle" type="integer" ticks="0,45,90,135,180,225,270,315" />
        <slider id="angle_s" default="45.0" min="0.0" max="360.0" label="Specular Angle" type="integer" ticks="0,45,90,135,180,225,270,315" />
        <color id="color_d" default="#FFFFFFFF" label="Diffuse Color" alpha="false" />
        <color id="color_s" default="#FFFFFFFF" label="Specular Color" alpha="false" />
        <slider id="intensity_d" default="0.1" min="0.0" max="1.0" label="Diffuse Intensity" />
        <slider id="intensity_s" default="0.9" min="0.0" max="1.0" label="Specular Intensity" />
        <slider id="elevation_d" default="1.0" min="0.0" max="5.0" label="Diffuse Elevation" />
        <slider id="elevation_s" default="2.5" min="0.0" max="5.0" label="Specular Elevation" />
        <slider id="spec" default="30.0" min="1.0" max="50.0" label="Specular Coefficient" />
        <slider id="refract" default="0.2" min="0.0" max="2.0" label="Refraction" />
        <slider id="fill" default="0.0" min="0.0" max="1.0" label="Fill" type="percent" />
    </params>

    <passes>
        <pass target="xDistBuf" />
        <pass />
    </passes>

    <shader type="fragment"><![CDATA[

        #define MULTISAMPLE 1.0
        #define MAX_RADIUS 16383.0

        vec2 encodeFloat(float v) {
            highp vec2 enc = fract(vec2(1.0, 255.0)*v);
            enc.x -= enc.y/255.0;
            return enc;
        }

        float decodeFloat(vec2 v) {
            return dot(v,vec2(1.0,1.0/255.0));
        }

        void main() {

            //float radius=max(max(innerBorderSize,outerBorderSize),centerBorderSize)*MULTISAMPLE;

            int from = -max(1,int(radius));
            int to = max(1,int(radius));

            // Size of a pixel
            vec2 imgSize = getTexSize(inputImg.size);
            float px = (1.0/imgSize.x);
            float py = (1.0/imgSize.y);

            if( acPass==0 ) {

                // Calculate distance on X-axis and encode in a texture

                float nearestLeft = MAX_RADIUS;
                float nearestRight = MAX_RADIUS;

                for(int i=from; i<0; i++ ) {
                    float x = float(i);
                    vec4 sample = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,vec2(acScreenNorm.s + x*(px/MULTISAMPLE),acScreenNorm.t));
                    float dist = sample.a < 0.003 ? abs(x) : radius*2.0;
                    nearestLeft = min(nearestLeft,dist);
                }

                for(int i=0; i<to; i++ ) {
                    float x = float(i);
                    vec4 sample = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,vec2(acScreenNorm.s + x*(px/MULTISAMPLE),acScreenNorm.t));
                    float dist = sample.a < 0.003 ? abs(x) : radius*2.0;
                    nearestRight = min(nearestRight,dist);
                }

                gl_FragColor = vec4(encodeFloat(nearestLeft/MAX_RADIUS),encodeFloat(nearestRight/MAX_RADIUS));

            } else {

                float as = angle_s * 0.0174533;
                float ad = angle_d * 0.0174533;
                vec3 light_s = vec3( cos(as), -sin(as), -elevation_s );
                vec3 light_d = vec3( cos(ad), -sin(ad), -elevation_d );

                // Final pass

                float nearestTopLeft        = MAX_RADIUS;
                float nearestTopRight       = MAX_RADIUS;
                float nearestBottomLeft     = MAX_RADIUS;
                float nearestBottomRight    = MAX_RADIUS;

                for(int i=from; i<0; i++ ) {

                    float y = float(i);

                    vec4 sample = texture2DCv(xDistBuf.texture,vec2(acScreenNorm.s,acScreenNorm.t + y*(py/MULTISAMPLE)));

                    float nearestLeft = decodeFloat(sample.rg) * MAX_RADIUS;
                    float nearestRight = decodeFloat(sample.ba) * MAX_RADIUS;
                    float ydist = abs(y);
                    float ldist = length(vec2(nearestLeft,ydist));
                    float rdist = length(vec2(nearestRight,ydist));

                    nearestBottomLeft = min(nearestBottomLeft,ldist);
                    nearestBottomRight = min(nearestBottomRight,rdist);
                }

                for(int i=0; i<to; i++ ) {

                    float y = float(i);

                    vec4 sample = texture2DCv(xDistBuf.texture,vec2(acScreenNorm.s,acScreenNorm.t + y*(py/MULTISAMPLE)));

                    float nearestLeft = decodeFloat(sample.rg) * MAX_RADIUS;
                    float nearestRight = decodeFloat(sample.ba) * MAX_RADIUS;
                    float ydist = abs(y);
                    float ldist = length(vec2(nearestLeft,ydist));
                    float rdist = length(vec2(nearestRight,ydist));

                    nearestTopLeft = min(nearestTopLeft,ldist);
                    nearestTopRight = min(nearestTopRight,rdist);
                }

                float nearestInside = nearestTopRight;

                vec4 original = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,acScreenNorm.st);

                nearestTopLeft = smoothstep(0.0,1.0, nearestTopLeft/(radius/MULTISAMPLE));
                nearestTopRight = smoothstep(0.0,1.0, nearestTopRight/(radius/MULTISAMPLE));
                nearestBottomLeft = smoothstep(0.0,1.0, nearestBottomLeft/(radius/MULTISAMPLE));
                nearestBottomRight = smoothstep(0.0,1.0, nearestBottomRight/(radius/MULTISAMPLE));

                vec3 v = (vec3(-1.0,-1.0,-1.0)*nearestBottomLeft + vec3(1.0,-1.0,-1.0)*nearestBottomRight + vec3(-1.0,1.0,-1.0)*nearestTopLeft + vec3(1.0,1.0,-1.0)*nearestTopRight) / 4.0; // / (radius/MULTISAMPLE);

                vec4 refractColor = texture2DCv(comp.texture,acScreenNorm.st + v.xy*refract);


                //vec4 innerBorderColor = vec4(1.0,0.5,0.0,1.0);

                //vec4 inColor = radius<0.003 ? vec4(0.0)  : mix(innerBorderColor,  vec4(0.0), smoothstep(1.0-1.5/radius,1.0,nearestInside/(radius/MULTISAMPLE))) * original.a;
                //vec4 inColor = vec4(nearestTopLeft/(radius/MULTISAMPLE), nearestTopRight/(radius/MULTISAMPLE), nearestBottomLeft/(radius/MULTISAMPLE), 1.0 );

                //vec4 inColor = vec4(vec2(0.5,0.5)+v, 0.5, 1.0 )*original.a;

                float lum_s = pow(dot(normalize(v),normalize(light_s)),spec);
                float lum_d = dot(normalize(v),normalize(light_d));

                vec4 lit_color_s = color_s * lum_s * intensity_s * original.a;
                vec4 lit_color_d = color_d * lum_d * intensity_d * original.a;

                vec4 over_a = original * fill;

                vec4 result = refractColor * original.a;
                result = over_a + result*(1.0-over_a.a);
                result = lit_color_d + result*(1.0-lit_color_d.a);
                result = lit_color_s + result*(1.0-lit_color_s.a);
                gl_FragColor = result;
            }
        }

    ]]></shader>

</effect>

    <!--<strings>-->

    <params>

        <section text="@am:string/effect_param_lighting" />
        <spinner id="angle" default="45.0" min="0.0" max="3600.0" label="@am:string/effect_param_angle" type="angle" ticks="0,45,90,135,180,225,270,315" step="0.5" />
        <spinner id="elevation" default="2.5" min="0.0" max="5.0" label="@am:string/effect_param_elevation" step="0.01" ticks="0.5,1,1.5,2,2.5,3,3.5,4,4.5" />
        <spinner id="intensity" default="1.0" min="0.0" max="2.0" label="@am:string/effect_param_intensity" step="0.01" ticks="1" />
        <color id="color_d" default="#FFFFFFFF" label="@am:string/effect_param_color" alpha="false" />
        <color id="color_s" default="#FFFFFFFF" label="@am:string/effect_param_shine" alpha="false" />

        <section text="@am:string/effect_param_material" />
        <spinner id="refract" default="0.25" min="0.0" max="2.0" label="@am:string/effect_param_refraction" step="0.01" ticks="0.25,0.5,0.75,1,1.25,1.5,1.75" />
        <spinner id="shine" default="0.8" min="0.0" max="1.0" label="@am:string/effect_param_shine" step="0.01" ticks="0.5" />
        <spinner id="spec" default="30.0" min="1.0" max="50.0" label="@am:string/effect_param_specularity" step="0.5" ticks="30.0" />
        <spinner id="fill" default="0.0" min="0.0" max="1.0" label="@am:string/effect_param_fill" type="percent" step="0.01" ticks="0.5" />
    </params>

    <passes>
        <pass target="xDistBuf" />
        <pass />
    </passes>

    <shader type="fragment"><![CDATA[

        #define MULTISAMPLE 1.0
        #define MAX_RADIUS 16383.0

        vec2 encodeFloat(float v) {
            highp vec2 enc = fract(vec2(1.0, 255.0)*v);
            enc.x -= enc.y/255.0;
            return enc;
        }

        float decodeFloat(vec2 v) {
            return dot(v,vec2(1.0,1.0/255.0));
        }

        void main() {

            float angle_d = angle;
            float angle_s = angle;
            float elevation_d = elevation;
            float elevation_s = elevation;
            float intensity_d = intensity * (1.-shine);
            float intensity_s = intensity * shine;

            //float radius=max(max(innerBorderSize,outerBorderSize),centerBorderSize)*MULTISAMPLE;
            float radius2 = radius * length(getTexSize(inputImg.size))/length(vec2(1024, 1024));

            int from = -max(1,int(radius2));
            int to = max(1,int(radius2));

            // Size of a pixel
            vec2 imgSize = getTexSize(inputImg.size);
            float px = (1.0/imgSize.x);
            float py = (1.0/imgSize.y);

            if( acPass==0 ) {

                // Calculate distance on X-axis and encode in a texture

                float nearestLeft = MAX_RADIUS;
                float nearestRight = MAX_RADIUS;

                for(int i=from; i<0; i++ ) {
                    float x = float(i);
                    vec4 sample = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,vec2(acScreenNorm.s + x*(px/MULTISAMPLE),acScreenNorm.t));
                    float dist = sample.a < 0.003 ? abs(x) : radius2*2.0;
                    nearestLeft = min(nearestLeft,dist);
                }

                for(int i=0; i<to; i++ ) {
                    float x = float(i);
                    vec4 sample = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,vec2(acScreenNorm.s + x*(px/MULTISAMPLE),acScreenNorm.t));
                    float dist = sample.a < 0.003 ? abs(x) : radius2*2.0;
                    nearestRight = min(nearestRight,dist);
                }

                gl_FragColor = vec4(encodeFloat(nearestLeft/MAX_RADIUS),encodeFloat(nearestRight/MAX_RADIUS));

            } else {

                float as = angle_s * 0.0174533;
                float ad = angle_d * 0.0174533;
                vec3 light_s = vec3( cos(as), -sin(as), -elevation_s );
                vec3 light_d = vec3( cos(ad), -sin(ad), -elevation_d );

                // Final pass

                float nearestTopLeft        = MAX_RADIUS;
                float nearestTopRight       = MAX_RADIUS;
                float nearestBottomLeft     = MAX_RADIUS;
                float nearestBottomRight    = MAX_RADIUS;

                for(int i=from; i<0; i++ ) {

                    float y = float(i);

                    vec4 sample = texture2DCv(xDistBuf.texture,vec2(acScreenNorm.s,acScreenNorm.t + y*(py/MULTISAMPLE)));

                    float nearestLeft = decodeFloat(sample.rg) * MAX_RADIUS;
                    float nearestRight = decodeFloat(sample.ba) * MAX_RADIUS;
                    float ydist = abs(y);
                    float ldist = length(vec2(nearestLeft,ydist));
                    float rdist = length(vec2(nearestRight,ydist));

                    nearestBottomLeft = min(nearestBottomLeft,ldist);
                    nearestBottomRight = min(nearestBottomRight,rdist);
                }

                for(int i=0; i<to; i++ ) {

                    float y = float(i);

                    vec4 sample = texture2DCv(xDistBuf.texture,vec2(acScreenNorm.s,acScreenNorm.t + y*(py/MULTISAMPLE)));

                    float nearestLeft = decodeFloat(sample.rg) * MAX_RADIUS;
                    float nearestRight = decodeFloat(sample.ba) * MAX_RADIUS;
                    float ydist = abs(y);
                    float ldist = length(vec2(nearestLeft,ydist));
                    float rdist = length(vec2(nearestRight,ydist));

                    nearestTopLeft = min(nearestTopLeft,ldist);
                    nearestTopRight = min(nearestTopRight,rdist);
                }

                float nearestInside = nearestTopRight;

                vec4 original = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,acScreenNorm.st);

                nearestTopLeft = smoothstep(0.0,1.0, nearestTopLeft/(radius2/MULTISAMPLE));
                nearestTopRight = smoothstep(0.0,1.0, nearestTopRight/(radius2/MULTISAMPLE));
                nearestBottomLeft = smoothstep(0.0,1.0, nearestBottomLeft/(radius2/MULTISAMPLE));
                nearestBottomRight = smoothstep(0.0,1.0, nearestBottomRight/(radius2/MULTISAMPLE));

                vec3 v = (vec3(-1.0,-1.0,-1.0)*nearestBottomLeft + vec3(1.0,-1.0,-1.0)*nearestBottomRight + vec3(-1.0,1.0,-1.0)*nearestTopLeft + vec3(1.0,1.0,-1.0)*nearestTopRight) / 4.0; // / (radius2/MULTISAMPLE);

                vec4 refractColor = texture2DCv(comp.texture,acScreenNorm.st + v.xy*refract);


                //vec4 innerBorderColor = vec4(1.0,0.5,0.0,1.0);

                //vec4 inColor = radius2<0.003 ? vec4(0.0)  : mix(innerBorderColor,  vec4(0.0), smoothstep(1.0-1.5/radius2,1.0,nearestInside/(radius2/MULTISAMPLE))) * original.a;
                //vec4 inColor = vec4(nearestTopLeft/(radius2/MULTISAMPLE), nearestTopRight/(radius2/MULTISAMPLE), nearestBottomLeft/(radius2/MULTISAMPLE), 1.0 );

                //vec4 inColor = vec4(vec2(0.5,0.5)+v, 0.5, 1.0 )*original.a;

                float lum_s = pow(dot(normalize(v),normalize(light_s)),spec);
                float lum_d = dot(normalize(v),normalize(light_d));

                vec4 lit_color_s = color_s * lum_s * intensity_s * original.a;
                vec4 lit_color_d = color_d * lum_d * intensity_d * original.a;

                vec4 over_a = original * fill;

                vec4 result = refractColor * original.a;
                result = over_a + result*(1.0-over_a.a);
                result = lit_color_d + result*(1.0-lit_color_d.a);
                result = lit_color_s + result*(1.0-lit_color_s.a);
                gl_FragColor = result;
            }
        }

    ]]></shader>

</effect>

<effect id="com.alightcreative.effects.glint" compat="acScreenNorm-y" name="glint" desc="glint" tags="color" thumb="thumb/star.webp" experimental="true">

    <params>
        <texture id="src" srcType="content" />
        <texture id="inputImg" srcType="buffer" downsample="2" />
        <spinner id="rayAngle" default="0.0" min="-1000000.0" max="1000000.0" step="0.1" label="angle" />
        <spinner id="rayCount" default="4.0" min="2.0" max="12.0" step="1" label="ray count" />
        <spinner id="strength" default="0.15" min="0.0" max="4.0" step="0.01" label="@am:string/effect_param_length" />
        <spinner id="intensity" default="1.0" min="0.0" max="5.0" step="0.01" label="@am:string/effect_param_intensity" />
        <spinner id="threshold" default="0.6" min="0.0" max="1.0" step="0.01" label="@am:string/effect_param_threshold" />
        <color id="thresholdColor" default="#FF000000" label="@am:string/effect_param_threshold_add" alpha="false" />
        <color id="fillColor" default="#FF0088FF" label="@am:string/effect_param_color" alpha="false" />
        <slider id="blend" default="0.00" min="0.0" max="1" label="@am:string/effect_param_blend" type="percent" />
        <slider id="quality" default="150.0" min="10.0" max="800.0" step="1" label="@am:string/effect_param_quality" ticks="150" />
    </params>
    
    <passes>
        <pass target="inputImg" />
        <pass />
    </passes>

    <shader type="fragment" precision="high"><![CDATA[

        const vec3 luminanceWeighting = vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722);
        
        vec4 calcGlint(vec2 vnorm, int nSamples, vec2 offsetScale) {
            
            vec4 output = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
            for(int i=1; i<nSamples; i++ ) {
                float p = float(i) / float(nSamples - 1);
                vec2 offs = vnorm * p;
                offs *= offsetScale;
                
                vec2 st1 = acScreenNorm.st-offs;
                vec4 texColor1 = (st1.x < 0. || st1.x > 1. || st1.y < 0. || st1.y > 1.) ? vec4(0.) : texture2DCv(inputImg.texture, st1);
                float luminance = dot(texColor1.rgb - thresholdColor.rgb, luminanceWeighting);
                output += luminance > threshold ? mix(texColor1,fillColor,blend)*(1.-p) : vec4(0.0);
            }
            return output;
        }
        
        #define PI 3.1415926536

        void main() {
            if( acPass == 0 ) {
                gl_FragColor = texture2DCv(src.texture, acScreenNorm.st);
            }
            else {
                vec2 texelSize = 1.0 / getTexSize(inputImg.size);
                float speed = length(strength / 2.0 / texelSize);
                int nSamples = int(quality)/2;
                vec4 baseColor = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,acScreenNorm.st);
                
                vec2 offsetScale = vec2(1., 1.);
                if( acScreenSize.y > acScreenSize.x ) {
                    offsetScale.x *= acScreenSize.x / acScreenSize.y;
                } else {
                    offsetScale.y *= acScreenSize.y / acScreenSize.x;
                }
                
                float angle = 360.0 / rayCount;
                vec4 outColor = vec4(0.);
                for(float i = 0.0; i < rayCount; i += 1.0) {
                    float curRad = (angle*i + rayAngle) / 180.0 * PI;
                    vec2 vnorm = vec2(cos(curRad),sin(curRad))*texelSize*speed;;
                    outColor += calcGlint(vnorm, nSamples, offsetScale);
                }
                gl_FragColor = baseColor + outColor * intensity / float(nSamples);
            }
        }

    ]]></shader>

</effect>

<effect id="com.alightcreative.inner-glow" compat="acScreenNorm-y" name="@am:string/effect_glowinner_name" desc="@am:string/effect_glowinner_desc" category="drawing" tags="edge,drawing,neon,raster" thumb="thumb/glowinner.webp">

        #define MULTISAMPLE 1.0

        }

        void main() {

            float q = max(pow(radius2,1.24)/radius2,radius2/40.0);

            if( acPass==0 ) {

                    float xdistOut = decodeFloat(sample.rg) * MAX_RADIUS;
                    float xdistIn = decodeFloat(sample.ba) * MAX_RADIUS;
                    float ydist = abs(y);
                    float distOut = length(vec2(xdistOut,ydist));
                    float distIn = length(vec2(xdistIn,ydist));
                    nearestInside = min(nearestInside,distIn);
                    nearestOutside = min(nearestOutside,distOut);
                }

                //float pIn = nearestInside/(radius2/MULTISAMPLE);
                //float pOut = nearestOutside/(radius2/MULTISAMPLE);
                //float p = smoothstep(0., 1., clamp(1. - pIn,0., 1.))/2.0;
                ////if( p <= 0.0001 )
                ////    discard;
//
                //vec4 original = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,acScreenNorm.st);
                //vec4 compColor = original; // texture2DCv(comp.texture,acScreenNorm.st);
                ////vec4 offsetOriginal = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,vec2(acScreenNorm.s + (-sdx)*(px/MULTISAMPLE),acScreenNorm.t + (sdy)*(py/MULTISAMPLE)));
//
                ////float nearestMid = max(nearestInside, nearestOutside);

                ////vec4 outColor = radius2<0.003 ? vec4(0.0)  : mix(color*alpha,  vec4(0.0), smoothstep((1.0-1.5/radius2)*hardness,1.0,nearestOutside/(radius2/MULTISAMPLE)));
//

//

//
                //vec4 result = outColor;
                //result = original + result*original.a;
                //gl_FragColor = result;

                float p = smoothstep(radius2+0.51, hardness*radius2-0.51, nearestInside);
                vec4 texColor = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,acScreenNorm);
                vec4 result;
                if( blendMode==1 ) {
                    result = vec4((texColor.rgb/texColor.a)*color.rgb,1.0) * texColor.a;
                } else if( blendMode==2 ) {
                    result = vec4( 1.-((1.-(texColor.rgb/texColor.a))*(1.-color.rgb)),1.0) * texColor.a;
                } else {
                    result = vec4(color.rgb,1.0)*texColor.a;
                }
                gl_FragColor = mix(texColor,result,alpha*p);

            }
        }

<effect id="com.alightcreative.glow" compat="acScreenNorm-y" name="@am:string/effect_glow_name" desc="@am:string/effect_glow_desc" category="drawing" tags="drawing,edge,neon,classic,raster" thumb="thumb/glow.png">

    <!--<strings>-->

    <params>

            <choice label="@am:string/effect_param_screen" value="2" />
        </selector>

    <shader type="fragment"><![CDATA[

        #define MULTISAMPLE 1.0
        #define MAX_RADIUS 16383.0

        vec2 encodeFloat(float v) {
            highp vec2 enc = fract(vec2(1.0, 255.0)*v);
            enc.x -= enc.y/255.0;
            return enc;
        }

        float decodeFloat(vec2 v) {
            return dot(v,vec2(1.0,1.0/255.0));
        }

        void main() {

            float radius2 = radius * length(inputImg.size) / length(vec2(1024, 1024));
            if( radius2 < 0.5 ) {
                gl_FragColor = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,acScreenNorm.st);
                return;
            }

            //float q = 11.0 - quality;
            float q = max(pow(radius2,1.24)/radius2,radius2/40.0);

            float sdx = 0.0;
            float sdy = 0.0;

            int from = -max(1,int(radius2/q));
            int to = max(1,int(radius2/q));

            // Size of a pixel
            vec2 imgSize = getTexSize(inputImg.size);
            float px = (1.0/imgSize.x);
            float py = (1.0/imgSize.y);

            if( acPass==0 ) {

                // Calculate distance on X-axis and encode in a texture

                float nearestOutside = MAX_RADIUS;
                float nearestInside = MAX_RADIUS;

                for(int i=from; i<to; i++ ) {
                    float x = float(i)*q;
                    vec4 sample = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,vec2(acScreenNorm.s + (x-sdx)*(px/MULTISAMPLE),acScreenNorm.t));
                    float xdistOut = sample.a > 0.0 ? abs(x) : radius2*2.0;
                    float xdistIn = sample.a < 0.003 ? abs(x) : radius2*2.0;
                    nearestOutside = min(nearestOutside,xdistOut);
                    nearestInside = min(nearestInside,xdistIn);
                }

                gl_FragColor = vec4(encodeFloat(nearestOutside/MAX_RADIUS),encodeFloat(nearestInside/MAX_RADIUS));

            } else {

                float nearestOutside = MAX_RADIUS;
                float nearestInside = MAX_RADIUS;

                for(int i=from; i<to; i++ ) {
                    float y = float(i)*q;

                    vec4 sample = texture2DCv(xDistBuf.texture,vec2(acScreenNorm.s,acScreenNorm.t + (y+sdy)*(py/MULTISAMPLE)));
                    float xdistOut = decodeFloat(sample.rg) * MAX_RADIUS;
                    float xdistIn = decodeFloat(sample.ba) * MAX_RADIUS;
                    float ydist = abs(y);
                    float distOut = length(vec2(xdistOut,ydist));
                    float distIn = length(vec2(xdistIn,ydist));
                    nearestInside = min(nearestInside,distIn);
                    nearestOutside = min(nearestOutside,distOut);
                }

                float pIn = nearestInside/(radius2/MULTISAMPLE);
                float pOut = nearestOutside/(radius2/MULTISAMPLE);
                float p = 0.5 + pIn - pOut;
                if( p <= 0.0001 )
                    discard;

                vec4 original = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,acScreenNorm.st);
                vec4 compColor = texture2DCv(comp.texture,acScreenNorm.st);
                //vec4 offsetOriginal = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,vec2(acScreenNorm.s + (-sdx)*(px/MULTISAMPLE),acScreenNorm.t + (sdy)*(py/MULTISAMPLE)));

                //float nearestMid = max(nearestInside, nearestOutside);
                //float qr = ((radius2/MULTISAMPLE)/4.0);
                //float hr = ((radius2/MULTISAMPLE)/2.0);
                //float nearestSolidInner = (max(0.0,hr - nearestInside) * (1.0-offsetOriginal.a))-max(0.0,nearestOutside-hr);

                //vec4 outColor = radius2<0.003 ? vec4(0.0)  : mix(color*alpha,  vec4(0.0), smoothstep((1.0-1.5/radius2)*hardness,1.0,nearestOutside/(radius2/MULTISAMPLE)));

                vec4 blendColor;

                if( blendMode==0 ) {
                    blendColor = vec4(color.rgb, 1.0);
                } else if( blendMode==1 ) {
                    blendColor = vec4( compColor.rgb * color.rgb, 1.0 );
                } else {
                    blendColor = vec4( 1.-( 1.-compColor.rgb) * (1.-color.rgb) , 1.0 );
                }

                vec4 outColor = radius2<0.003 ? vec4(0.0)  : mix(blendColor*alpha,  vec4(0.0), smoothstep((1.0-1.5/radius2)*hardness,1.0,1.0-p));

                vec4 result = blendMode==0 ? vec4(outColor.rgb, outColor.a * color.a) : outColor;
                result = original + result*(1.0-original.a);
                gl_FragColor = result;
            }
        }

    ]]></shader>

<effect id="com.alightcreative.effects.glowscan" compat="acScreenNorm-y" name="@am:string/effect_glowscan_name" desc="@am:string/effect_glowscan_desc" category="drawing" tags="edge,drawing,neon,raster,membersOnly" thumb="thumb/glowscan.webp" >

    <params>
        <texture id="inputImg" srcType="content" />
        <texture id="hblur" srcType="buffer" />
        <spinner id="threshold" default="0.5" min="0.0" max="1.0" step="0.01" label="@am:string/effect_param_threshold" />
        <spinner id="radius" default="0.1" min="0.0" max="1.0" step="0.01" label="@am:string/effect_param_radius" />
        <spinner id="power" default="2.0" min="0.0" max="4.0" step="0.01" label="@am:string/effect_param_feather" />
        <spinner id="strength" default="0.05" min="0.0" max="2.0" step="0.01" label="@am:string/effect_param_smoothing" />
        <color id="fillColor" default="#FF0088FF" label="@am:string/effect_param_color" alpha="false" />
        <slider id="blend" default="0.00" min="0.0" max="1" label="@am:string/effect_param_blend" type="percent" />
        <spinner id="fill" default="1.00" min="0.0" max="1" label="@am:string/effect_param_fill" type="percent" />
        <spinner id="alpha" default="1.00" min="0.0" max="1" label="@am:string/effect_param_alpha" type="percent" />
    </params>

    <passes>
        <pass target="hblur" effect="com.alightcreative.effects.gaussianblur"/>
        <pass />
    </passes>

    <shader type="fragment" precision="high"><![CDATA[

        const vec3 luminanceWeighting = vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722);


        void main() {
            if( acPass==0 ) {

                discard;
            } else {
                vec4 baseColor =  texture2DCv(hblur.texture, acScreenNorm.st);
                vec4 mainColor = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,acScreenNorm.st) * fill;
                float luma = dot(baseColor.rgb, luminanceWeighting);
                float adjThreshold = threshold * (1.0 + radius) - radius;
                if(luma >= adjThreshold && luma <= adjThreshold + radius)
                {
                    float halfRadius = radius*0.5;
                    float linearPos = abs((luma - adjThreshold - halfRadius)/halfRadius);
                    vec4 glow = pow(mix(baseColor, fillColor*luma, blend*0.99), vec4(power) * pow(linearPos, 2.0));
                    mainColor = mix(mainColor, baseColor + glow, alpha);
                }
                gl_FragColor = mainColor;
            }
        }

    ]]></shader>

</effect>

<effect id="com.alightcreative.effects.gradientdisplace" compat="acScreenNorm-y" name="@am:string/effect_gradientdisplace_name" desc="@am:string/effect_gradientdisplace_desc" category="distort" thumb="thumb/testicon.png" experimental="true" deprecated="false">

    <params>
        <texture id="inputImg" srcType="content" />
        <texture id="comp" srcType="comp" />
        <spinner id="strength" default="0.1" min="-100" max="100" step="0.001" label="@am:string/effect_param_strength" ticks="0." />
        <spinner id="smoothing" default="1." min="0.125" max="5." step="0.01" label="@am:string/effect_param_smoothing" />
    </params>

    <shader type="fragment" precision="high"><![CDATA[

        const vec3 luminanceWeighting = vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722);

        void main() {

            vec2 st = acScreenNorm;
            vec2 fragSize = vec2(1.)/getTexSize(inputImg.size) * (smoothing*24.);
            vec4 leftColor = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture, vec2(acScreenNorm.x - fragSize.x, acScreenNorm.y) );
            vec4 rightColor = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture, vec2(acScreenNorm.x + fragSize.x, acScreenNorm.y) );
            vec4 topColor = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture, vec2(acScreenNorm.x, acScreenNorm.y + fragSize.y) );
            vec4 bottomColor = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture, vec2(acScreenNorm.x, acScreenNorm.y - fragSize.y) );

            float left   = length(leftColor.rgb*luminanceWeighting);
            float right  = length(rightColor.rgb*luminanceWeighting);
            float top    = length(topColor.rgb*luminanceWeighting);
            float bottom = length(bottomColor.rgb*luminanceWeighting);

            vec2 gradient = normalize(vec2((right - left) / (2.*fragSize.x), (top - bottom) / (2.*fragSize.y)));

            float alpha = 1.0;
            alpha = min(alpha,leftColor.a);
            alpha = min(alpha,rightColor.a);
            alpha = min(alpha,topColor.a);
            alpha = min(alpha,bottomColor.a);

            gl_FragColor = texture2DCv(comp.texture,st+gradient*strength)*alpha;

        }

    ]]></shader>

</effect>

<effect id="com.alightcreative.gradientoverlay" compat="acScreenNorm-y" name="@am:string/effect_gradientoverlay_name" desc="@am:string/effect_gradientoverlay_desc" category="color" tags="color,gradient,raster" thumb="thumb/gradover.webp" deprecated="true">

    <params>
        <texture id="inputImg" srcType="content" />
        <color id="color1" default="#FFEE5533" label="@am:string/effect_param_color1" alpha="true" />
        <color id="color2" default="#FFFFEE88" label="@am:string/effect_param_color2" alpha="true" />
        <spinner id="angle" default="0.0" min="0.0" max="3600.0" label="@am:string/effect_param_angle" type="angle" step="0.5" ticks="0,45,90,135,180,225,270,315,360" snap="45,90,135" />
        <point id="offset" label="@am:string/effect_param_offset" />
        <spinner id="scale" default="1.0" min="0" max="10.0" label="@am:string/effect_param_scale" step="0.01" ticks="1.0" />
        <spinner id="alpha" default="0.75" min="0.0" max="1.0" step="0.001" label="@am:string/effect_param_alpha" type="percent" />
        <selector id="gradType" style="radio" default="0">
            <choice label="@am:string/effect_param_grad_linear" value="0" />
            <choice label="@am:string/effect_param_grad_radial" value="1" />
            <choice label="@am:string/effect_param_grad_sweep" value="2" />
        </selector>
        <selector id="blendMode" style="dropdown" label="@am:string/effect_param_blendmode">
            <choice label="@am:string/effect_param_normal" value="0" />
            <choice label="@am:string/effect_param_multiply" value="1" />
            <choice label="@am:string/effect_param_screen" value="2" />
        </selector>
    </params>

    <shader type="fragment"><![CDATA[

        void main() {
            vec4 texColor = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,acScreenNorm);
            float a = angle * 0.0174533;
            vec2 st = acLayerNorm;
            st -= 0.5;
            st -= (offset*vec2(1,-1)) / 500.;
            st *= scale;
            st *= mat2(
                sin(a), -cos(a),
                cos(a), sin(a)
            );
            st += 0.5;
            float t;

            if( gradType == 0 ) {
                t = st.x;
            } else if ( gradType == 1 ) {
                t = length( st - 0.5 ) * 2.0;
            } else if ( gradType == 2 ) {
                vec2 xy = st - 0.5;
                vec2 zw = vec2(0,1.0);
                float a = atan(xy.x, xy.y);
                float b = atan(zw.x, zw.y);
                t = mod(((a-b)+6.28),6.28)/6.28;
            } else {
                t = st.x;
            }

            t = clamp(t,0.0,1.0);

            vec4 color = mix(color1, color2, t);
            vec4 result;
            if( blendMode==1 ) {
                result = vec4((texColor.rgb/texColor.a)*color.rgb,1.0) * texColor.a;
            } else if( blendMode==2 ) {
                result = vec4( 1.-((1.-(texColor.rgb/texColor.a))*(1.-color.rgb)),1.0) * texColor.a;
            } else {
                result = vec4(color.rgb,1.0)*texColor.a;
            }
            gl_FragColor = mix(texColor,result,alpha);
        }

    ]]></shader>

</effect>

<effect id="com.alightcreative.effects.grid" compat="acScreenNorm-y" name="@am:string/effect_grid_name" desc="@am:string/effect_grid_desc" category="procedural" tags="procedural,pattern,raster" thumb="thumb/grid2.png" deprecated="true">

    <params>
        <texture id="inputImg" srcType="content" />
        <point id="position" label="@am:string/effect_param_offset" />
        <spinner id="spacing" default=".1" min=".01" max="2.0" label="@am:string/effect_param_spacing" step="0.001" ticks="10" />
        <spinner id="width" default="0.005" min="0.0" max="2.0" label="@am:string/effect_param_width" step="0.001" ticks="0.5" />
        <color id="color" default="#FF2D1EF6" label="@am:string/effect_param_color" alpha="false" />
        <switch id="punchout" default="false" label="@am:string/effect_param_punchout" />
        <spinner id="smoothing" default="0.05" min="0.0" max="1.0" label="@am:string/effect_param_smoothing" />
        <switch id="screenSpace" default="false" label="@am:string/effect_param_screenspace" />
    </params>

    <shader type="fragment" precision="high"><![CDATA[

        vec2 l2s( vec2 v ) {
            return (vec4(v,0.,1.)*acLayerToScreen).xy;
        }

        void main() {
            vec4 texColor = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,acScreenNorm);
            vec2 st;
            if(screenSpace) {
                //st = ((vec2(acScreenNorm.x,1.0-acScreenNorm.y)*acScreenSize)-acLayerCenter)/length(acLayerSize);
                st = acScreenNorm;
                st.x *= acScreenSize.x/acScreenSize.y;
                st.y = 1. - st.y;
            } else {
                st = acLayerNorm;
                st.x *= acLayerSize.x/acLayerSize.y;
                st.y = 1. - st.y;
            }
            st -= 0.5;
            st -= position/1000.;

            float px = mod( st.x, spacing ) / spacing;
            float py = mod( st.y, spacing ) / spacing;

            px = 1.- abs(px - 0.5)*2.;
            py = 1.- abs(py - 0.5)*2.;

            float w = clamp(width/spacing,0.,1.);
            float s = w*smoothing;

            s = mix(s,max(s,0.5*w),smoothstep(0.012,0.01,width));
            s = mix(s,max(s,w),smoothstep(0.006,0.005,width));

            //px = smoothstep(w,w-s,px)*smoothstep(0.0,s,px);
            //py = smoothstep(w,w-s,py)*smoothstep(0.0,s,py);

            px = smoothstep(1.-w-s, 1.-w+s,px);
            py = smoothstep(1.-w-s, 1.-w+s,py);

            float p = max(px,py);

            vec4 c = color * p;
            if( punchout ) {
                gl_FragColor = texColor * (1.0-p);
            } else {
                c *= texColor.a;
                gl_FragColor = c + (texColor*(1.0-c.a));
            }
        }

    ]]></shader>

</effect>

    <passes>

    <shader type="fragment" precision="high"><![CDATA[

        const vec3 luminanceWeighting = vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722);
        
        mat2 rot2(float a) {
            float c = cos(a);
            float s = sin(a);
            return mat2(c,s,-s,c);
        }

        vec4 composite( vec4 a, vec4 b) {
            return a * (1. - b.a) + b;
        }

        float sampleGrain(vec2 uv, int grainType, float gamma, float contrast, float scale, float angle, vec2 offset, int invert) {
        
            uv -= 0.5;
            uv *= rot2(angle*0.0174533);
            uv /= scale;
            uv += 0.5;
            uv -= offset * vec2(1., -1.) / 500.;
            uv = fract(uv);

            float grainLuma;
            if( grainType == 1 ) {
                grainLuma = texture2D(grunge_a.texture,uv).r;
            } else if( grainType == 2 ) {
                grainLuma = texture2D(grunge_a.texture,uv).g;
            } else if( grainType == 3 ) {
                grainLuma = texture2D(grunge_a.texture,uv).b;
            } else if( grainType == 4 ) {
                grainLuma = texture2D(grunge_b.texture,uv).r;
            } else if( grainType == 5 ) {
                grainLuma = texture2D(grunge_b.texture,uv).g;
            } else if( grainType == 6 ) {
                grainLuma = texture2D(grunge_b.texture,uv).b;
            } else if( grainType == 7 ) {
                grainLuma = dot(texture2D(grunge_a.texture,uv).rgb, vec3(1.)) / 3.;
            } else if( grainType == 8 ) {
                grainLuma = dot(texture2D(grunge_b.texture,uv).rgb, vec3(1.)) / 3.;
            } else if( grainType == 9 ) {
                grainLuma = dot(texture2D(grunge_b.texture,uv).rb, vec2(1.)) / 2.;
            } else if( grainType == 10 ) {
                uv *= 16.;
                vec2 st = fract(uv);
                vec2 id = floor(uv);
                if( mod(id.x + id.y,2.) == 0. ) {
                    st = st.yx;
                }
                float pp = 6.;
                float p = pow(sin(st.x*3.14159*1.),pp);
                st = st.yx;
                float q = clamp(pow(sin(st.x*3.14159*1.),pp),0.,1.);
                p += q * pow((1.-p),10.);
                grainLuma = p;
            } else if( grainType == 11 ) {
                vec2 st = uv * 16.;
                vec2 id = floor(st);
                st = fract(st);
                if( mod(id.x + id.y,2.) == 0. ) {
                    st = st.yx;
                }
                float pp = 6.;
                float p = pow(sin(st.x*3.14159*1.),pp);
                st = st.yx;
                float q = clamp(pow(sin(st.x*3.14159*1.),pp),0.,1.);
                p += q * pow((1.-p),10.);
                p = saturate(p);
                float tc = texture2D(grunge_b.texture,uv).b;
                grainLuma = p * abs(p-tc); //p - (tc * (1.-p));
            } else if( grainType == 12 ) {
                grainLuma = sin(uv.y*30.*3.14159)*0.5+0.5;
            } else if( grainType == 13 ) {
                grainLuma = min(sin(uv.y*30.*3.14159)*0.5+0.5,sin(uv.x*30.*3.14159)*0.5+0.5);
            } else if( grainType == 14 ) {
                grainLuma = (sin(uv.y*30.*3.14159)*sin(uv.x*30.*3.14159))*0.5+0.5;
            } else if( grainType == 15 ) {
                grainLuma = uv.y;
            } else if( grainType == 16 ) {
                grainLuma = 1.0;
            } else {
                grainLuma = 0.5;
            }

            grainLuma = saturate(((grainLuma-0.5) * (1.+contrast)) + 0.5);
            grainLuma = pow(grainLuma,1.0/gamma);
            if( invert )
                grainLuma = 1.-grainLuma;

            return grainLuma;

        }
        
        vec2 applyDisplace(vec2 displace, vec4 blurColor, vec2 offset, int fromCtr, int region, vec2 uv, int grainType, float gamma, float contrast, float scale, float angle, vec2 texOffset) {
        
            float p;
            if( region == 1) {  // Edge
                p = 1. - saturate((blurColor.a-0.5) * 2.);
            } else if( region == 2 ) {  // Center
                p = saturate((blurColor.a-0.5) * 2.);
            } else if( region == 3 ) {  // Fill
                p = 1.;
            } else {
                p = 0.;
            }
            
            float g = sampleGrain( uv, grainType, gamma, contrast, scale, angle, texOffset, 0);
            
            if( fromCtr ) {
                g = (g - 0.5) * 2.;
            }
            
            return displace + (offset * vec2(1.,-1.) / 2000.) * g * p;
        }

        vec4 blendGrain(vec4 baseColor, vec4 originalColor, vec4 blurColor, vec4 color, float alpha, int blendMode, int region, float spread, float rawChoke, float burn, vec2 uv, int grainType, float gamma, float contrast, float scale, float angle, vec2 offset, int invert, int light, float lightAngle) {

            float choke = clamp(rawChoke,0.,0.999);
        
            float p;
            float m;
            if( region == 1) {  // Edge
                m = baseColor.a;
                p = 1. - saturate((blurColor.a-0.5) * 2.);
            } else if( region == 2 ) {  // Center
                m = baseColor.a;
                p = saturate((blurColor.a-0.5) * 2.);
            } else if( region == 3 ) {  // Fill
                m = baseColor.a;
                p = 1.;
            } else if( region == 4 ) {  // Glow
                m = 1.-baseColor.a;
                p = saturate(blurColor.a * 2. - baseColor.a);
            } else {
                m = 0.;
                p = 0.;
            }
            
            p = saturate((p-choke)/(max(1.-spread,choke+0.0001)-choke));
            float g;
            if( light ) {
                vec2 lv = vec2(.002, 0.) * rot2(lightAngle*0.0174533);
                float g1 = sampleGrain( uv+lv, grainType, gamma, contrast, scale, angle, offset, invert);
                float g2 = sampleGrain( uv-lv, grainType, gamma, contrast, scale, angle, offset, invert);
                g = saturate((g1-g2)*5.);
            } else {
                g = sampleGrain( uv, grainType, gamma, contrast, scale, angle, offset, invert);
            }
            
            vec4 c = color;
            if( burn < 0.0 ) {
                c.rgb = mix(c.rgb, 1.-(1.-c.rgb) * (1.-(0.5+c.rgb*0.5)), -burn * g*g );
            } else {
                c.rgb = mix(c.rgb, c.rgb * c.rgb * 0.25, burn * g * g );
            }
            c *= alpha * p * g;
            
            if( region==4 ) {
                return composite(baseColor,c * m);
            } else if( blendMode==1 ) { // Multiply
                vec3 baseRgb = baseColor.rgb / max(baseColor.a,0.00001);;
                vec3 rgb = c.rgb / max(c.a,0.00001);
                vec3 adj = baseRgb * rgb;
                return composite(baseColor,vec4(adj,1.) * c.a * baseColor.a);
            } else if( blendMode==2 ) { // Screen
                vec3 baseRgb = baseColor.rgb / max(baseColor.a,0.00001);;
                vec3 rgb = c.rgb / max(c.a,0.00001);
                vec3 adj = 1. - ((1.-baseRgb) * (1.-rgb));
                return composite(baseColor,vec4(adj,1.) * c.a * baseColor.a);
            } else if( blendMode==3 ) { // Punch out
                return baseColor * (1.-c.a);
            } else if( blendMode==4 ) { // Punch out
                return composite(baseColor,originalColor * (c.a * m));
            } else { // Normal
                return composite(baseColor,c * m);
            }
        
        }
        
        void main() {
        
            vec4 blurTexColor = texture2DCv(blurBuf.texture,acScreenNorm);
            vec2 uv = acLayerNorm;
            uv.x *= acLayerSize.x / acLayerSize.y;
            
            vec2 displace = vec2(0.);
            
            displace = applyDisplace(displace,blurTexColor,d1offset,d1fromctr,d1region,uv,int(d1grain),d1gamma,d1contrast,d1scale,d1angle,d1toffset);
            uv += displace;
            displace = applyDisplace(displace,blurTexColor,d2offset,d2fromctr,d2region,uv,int(d2grain),d2gamma,d2contrast,d2scale,d2angle,d2toffset);
            uv += displace;

            displace.x *= acScreenSize.x / acScreenSize.y;

            vec4 texColor = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,acScreenNorm + displace);

            texColor = mix(texColor,fillColor*texColor.a,fillColorBlend);

            vec4 result = texColor;
            
            result = blendGrain(result, texColor, blurTexColor, t1color, t1alpha, t1blendMode, t1active ? t1region : 0, t1spread, t1choke, t1burn, uv, int(t1grain), t1gamma, t1contrast, t1scale, t1angle, t1offset, t1invert, t1light, t1lightAngle);
            result = blendGrain(result, texColor, blurTexColor, t2color, t2alpha, t2blendMode, t2active ? t2region : 0, t2spread, t2choke, t2burn, uv, int(t2grain), t2gamma, t2contrast, t2scale, t2angle, t2offset, t2invert, t2light, t2lightAngle);
            result = blendGrain(result, texColor, blurTexColor, t3color, t3alpha, t3blendMode, t3active ? t3region : 0, t3spread, t3choke, t3burn, uv, int(t3grain), t3gamma, t3contrast, t3scale, t3angle, t3offset, t3invert, t3light, t3lightAngle);
            result = blendGrain(result, texColor, blurTexColor, t4color, t4alpha, t4blendMode, t4active ? t4region : 0, t4spread, t4choke, t4burn, uv, int(t4grain), t4gamma, t4contrast, t4scale, t4angle, t4offset, t4invert, t4light, t4lightAngle);
            result = blendGrain(result, texColor, blurTexColor, t5color, t5alpha, t5blendMode, t5active ? t5region : 0, t5spread, t5choke, t5burn, uv, int(t5grain), t5gamma, t5contrast, t5scale, t5angle, t5offset, t5invert, t5light, t5lightAngle);
            result = blendGrain(result, texColor, blurTexColor, t6color, t6alpha, t6blendMode, t6active ? t6region : 0, t6spread, t6choke, t6burn, uv, int(t6grain), t6gamma, t6contrast, t6scale, t6angle, t6offset, t6invert, t6light, t6lightAngle);
            result = blendGrain(result, texColor, blurTexColor, t7color, t7alpha, t7blendMode, t7active ? t7region : 0, t7spread, t7choke, t7burn, uv, int(t7grain), t7gamma, t7contrast, t7scale, t7angle, t7offset, t7invert, t7light, t7lightAngle);
            result = blendGrain(result, texColor, blurTexColor, t8color, t8alpha, t8blendMode, t8active ? t8region : 0, t8spread, t8choke, t8burn, uv, int(t8grain), t8gamma, t8contrast, t8scale, t8angle, t8offset, t8invert, t8light, t8lightAngle);

            gl_FragColor = result;

        }

    ]]></shader>

</effect>

<effect id="com.alightcreative.effects.halftonedotscmyk" compat="acScreenNorm-y" name="@am:string/effect_halftonedotscmyk_name" desc="@am:string/effect_halftonedotscmyk_desc" category="drawing" tags="drawing, color, pop, raster " thumb="thumb/cmykhalftone.webp">

    <params>
        <texture id="inputImg" srcType="content" />
        <spinner id="amount" default="100" min="0" max="500" label="@am:string/effect_param_amount" step="0.1" />
        <spinner id="strength" default="0.5" min="0" max="1" label="@am:string/effect_param_strength" step="0.001" ticks="0.5" />
        <spinner id="blackWeight" default="0.0" min="0" max="1" label="@am:string/effect_param_black" step="0.001" ticks="0.5" type="percent" />
        <spinner id="angle" default="45.0" min="0.0" max="3600.0" label="@am:string/effect_param_angle" type="angle" step="0.5" ticks="0,45,90,135,180,225,270,315,360" snap="45,90,135" />
        <spinner id="phase" default="0.5" min="-1000" max="1000.0" label="@am:string/effect_param_phase" step="0.01" ticks="-3,-2,-1.5,-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1,1.5,2,3" />
    </params>

    <shader type="fragment" precision="high"><![CDATA[

        const vec3 luminanceWeighting = vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722);

        float halftone(float a, vec4 mask) {

            float rad = a * 0.0174533;
            mat2 rot = mat2(cos(rad),-sin(rad),sin(rad),cos(rad));
            mat2 invrot = mat2(cos(-rad),-sin(-rad),sin(-rad),cos(-rad));

            vec2 st = acScreenNorm;

            st -= acLayerCenterNorm;
            st.y *= (acScreenSize.y/acScreenSize.x);
            st *= rot;

            // Y Distance

            float distY = mod(st.y*amount,1.);

            if( distY < 0.5 ) {
                distY = -distY;
            } else {
                distY = 1.0-distY;
            }

            float absDistY = abs(distY);

            distY /= amount;

            // X Distance

            float xoffs = step(1.,mod(st.y*amount+0.5,2.)) * phase;

            float distX = mod(st.x*amount+xoffs,1.);

            if( distX < 0.5 ) {
                distX = -distX;
            } else {
                distX = 1.0-distX;
            }

            float absDistX = abs(distX);

            distX /= amount;

            // Sampling

            st.y += distY;
            st.x += distX;

            st *= invrot;
            st.y /= (acScreenSize.y/acScreenSize.x);
            st += acLayerCenterNorm;

            vec4 samp = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,st);

            // CMYK

            float k = min(1.-samp.r, min(1.-samp.g, 1.-samp.b)) * blackWeight;
            float c = k>=1.0 ? 0.0 : ((1.0 - samp.r) - k) / (1.0-k);
            float m = k>=1.0 ? 0.0 : ((1.0 - samp.g) - k) / (1.0-k);
            float y = k>=1.0 ? 0.0 : ((1.0 - samp.b) - k) / (1.0-k);

            vec4 cmyk = vec4(c,m,y,k);

            float lum = length(cmyk*mask) / length(mask);

            float dist = length(vec2(absDistX,absDistY));
            float radius = strength*2.0;

            float mag = max(0., radius-dist);

            float p = smoothstep( 0.4,0.6, mag*lum) * samp.a;

            return p;
        }

        void main() {

            float c = halftone(angle+15., vec4(1., 0., 0., 0.));
            float m = halftone(angle+75., vec4(0., 1., 0., 0.));
            float y = halftone(angle+0., vec4(0., 0., 1., 0.));
            float k = halftone(angle+45., vec4(0., 0., 0., 1.));

            vec4 texColor = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,acScreenNorm);

            vec4 outColor = vec4(1.-c-k, 1.-m-k, 1.-y-k, 1.) * texColor.a;

            gl_FragColor = outColor;

        }

    ]]></shader>

</effect>

<effect id="com.alightcreative.effects.halftonedots" compat="acScreenNorm-y" name="@am:string/effect_halftonedots_name" desc="@am:string/effect_halftonedots_desc" category="drawing" tags="drawing,pop,raster" thumb="thumb/halftonedots.webp">

    <params>
        <texture id="inputImg" srcType="content" />
        <spinner id="amount" default="100" min="0" max="500" label="@am:string/effect_param_amount" step="0.1" />
        <spinner id="strength" default="0.5" min="0" max="1" label="@am:string/effect_param_strength" step="0.001" ticks="0.5" />
        <spinner id="angle" default="45.0" min="0.0" max="3600.0" label="@am:string/effect_param_angle" type="angle" step="0.5" ticks="0,45,90,135,180,225,270,315,360" snap="45,90,135" />
        <spinner id="phase" default="0.5" min="-1000" max="1000.0" label="@am:string/effect_param_phase" step="0.01" ticks="-3,-2,-1.5,-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1,1.5,2,3" />
        <color id="color1" default="#FF113355" label="@am:string/effect_param_color1" alpha="false" />
        <color id="color2" default="#FFFFEEDD" label="@am:string/effect_param_color2" alpha="false" />
    </params>

    <shader type="fragment" precision="high"><![CDATA[

        const vec3 luminanceWeighting = vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722);

        void main() {

            float rad = angle * 0.0174533;
            mat2 rot = mat2(cos(rad),-sin(rad),sin(rad),cos(rad));
            mat2 invrot = mat2(cos(-rad),-sin(-rad),sin(-rad),cos(-rad));

            vec2 st = acScreenNorm;

            st -= acLayerCenterNorm;
            st.y *= (acScreenSize.y/acScreenSize.x);
            st *= rot;

            // Y Distance

            float distY = mod(st.y*amount,1.);

            if( distY < 0.5 ) {
                distY = -distY;
            } else {
                distY = 1.0-distY;
            }

            float absDistY = abs(distY);

            distY /= amount;

            // X Distance

            float xoffs = step(1.,mod(st.y*amount+0.5,2.)) * phase;

            float distX = mod(st.x*amount+xoffs,1.);

            if( distX < 0.5 ) {
                distX = -distX;
            } else {
                distX = 1.0-distX;
            }

            float absDistX = abs(distX);

            distX /= amount;

            // Sampling

            st.y += distY;
            st.x += distX;

            st *= invrot;
            st.y /= (acScreenSize.y/acScreenSize.x);
            st += acLayerCenterNorm;

            vec4 samp = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,st);
            float lum = dot( samp.rgb, luminanceWeighting );

            float p = smoothstep( 0.4,0.6, lum + (1.-samp.a) + length(vec2(absDistX,absDistY)) + strength - 0.5);

            vec4 texColor = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,acScreenNorm);

            //vec4 color1 = vec4(0., 0., 0., 1.);
            //vec4 color2 = vec4(1., 1., 1., 1.);

            vec4 outColor = mix( color1, color2, p ) * texColor.a;

            gl_FragColor = outColor;

        }

    ]]></shader>

</effect>

<effect id="com.alightcreative.effects.hexarray" compat="acScreenNorm-y" name="@am:string/effect_hexarray_name" desc="@am:string/effect_hexarray_desc" category="procedural" tags="procedural,geometric,retro" thumb="thumb/hexarray.webp">

    <params>
        <texture id="inputImg" srcType="content" />
        <point id="position" label="@am:string/effect_param_offset" />
        <spinner id="size" default="10.0" min="0.5" max="200.0" label="@am:string/effect_param_size" step="0.1" ticks="10" />
        <spinner id="stretch" default="1.0" min="0.01" max="10.0" label="@am:string/effect_param_stretch" step="0.01" ticks="1" />
        <!--<spinner id="test" default="0.0" min="-100.0" max="100.0" label="Test" step="0.001" ticks="1" />-->

        <selector id="colorMode" style="dropdown" default="1" label="@am:string/effect_param_coloring">
            <choice label="@am:string/effect_param_coloring_layer" value="0" />
            <choice label="@am:string/effect_param_coloring_solid" value="1" />
            <choice label="@am:string/effect_param_coloring_stripes" value="2" />
            <choice label="@am:string/effect_param_coloring_tricolor" value="3" />
            <choice label="@am:string/effect_param_coloring_cube" value="4" />
            <choice label="@am:string/effect_param_coloring_triangles" value="5" />
            <choice label="@am:string/effect_param_coloring_pentagonal" value="6" />
        </selector>

        <color id="color1" default="#FF0000FF" label="@am:string/effect_param_color1" alpha="true" />
        <color id="color2" default="#FFFF0000" label="@am:string/effect_param_color2" alpha="true" />
        <color id="color3" default="#FF00FF00" label="@am:string/effect_param_color3" alpha="true" />
        <spinner id="alpha" default="1.0" min="0.0" max="1.0" step="0.01" label="@am:string/effect_param_alpha" type="percent" />

        <selector id="blendMode" style="dropdown" label="@am:string/effect_param_blendmode">
            <choice label="@am:string/effect_param_normal" value="0" />
            <choice label="@am:string/effect_param_multiply" value="1" />
            <choice label="@am:string/effect_param_screen" value="2" />
            <choice label="@am:string/effect_param_overlay" value="5" />
            <choice label="@am:string/effect_param_overflow" value="3" />
            <choice label="@am:string/effect_param_punchout" value="4" />
        </selector>

        <switch id="alphaScale" default="false" label="@am:string/effect_param_scale_using_layer_alpha" />
        <switch id="copyAlpha" default="false" label="@am:string/effect_param_copy_layer_alpha" />
        <spinner id="lineWidth" default="0.1" min="0.0" max="1.0" step="0.005" label="@am:string/effect_param_line_width" />
        <spinner id="feather" default="0.05" min="0.0" max="1.0" label="@am:string/effect_param_feather" />
        <spinner id="angle" default="0.0" min="0.0" max="3600.0" label="@am:string/effect_param_angle" type="angle" ticks="0,45,90,135,180,225,270,315,360" step="0.5" />
        <switch id="screenSpace" default="false" label="@am:string/effect_param_screenspace" />
    </params>

    <shader type="fragment" precision="high"><![CDATA[

        const float PI = 3.14159;
        const float ulp = PI/240.;

        const vec2 hexRatio = vec2(1.0, 1.73);
        const vec2 hexRatioNorm = normalize(hexRatio);

        float hexDist(vec2 p) {
            return max(dot(abs(p), hexRatioNorm), abs(p.x));
        }

        void hexTile(vec2 st, thread vec2& uv, thread vec2& huv, thread vec2& id) {
            vec2 grid = mod(st, hexRatio)-hexRatio/2.;
            vec2 offsetGrid = mod(st-hexRatio/2., hexRatio)-hexRatio/2.;
            uv = length(grid) < length(offsetGrid) ? grid : offsetGrid;
            huv = vec2(atan(uv.x, uv.y), (.5-hexDist(uv))*2.);
            id = vec2(st.x-uv.x, st.y-uv.y);
        }

        mat2 rot(float a) {
            float c = cos(a);
            float s = sin(a);
            return mat2(
                c, -s,
                s, c
            );
        }

        vec2 l2s( vec2 v, mat4 acLTS ) {
            return (vec4(v,0.,1.)*acLTS).xy;
        }


        void main() {
            vec4 texColor = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,acScreenNorm);
            vec2 st;
            if(screenSpace) {
                st = acScreenNorm;
                st -= 0.5;
                st.x *= acScreenSize.x/acScreenSize.y;
            } else {
                st = acLayerNorm;
                st -= 0.5;
                st.x *= acLayerSize.x/acLayerSize.y;
            }
            
            vec2 scale = vec2(size/100., size/100. * stretch);
            vec2 pos = (position/500.) * vec2(1., -1.);

            st /= scale;

            st *= rot(angle * 0.0174533);

            pos *= rot(-angle * 0.0174533);

            vec2 modPos = mod(pos,hexRatio*2.);
            vec2 basePos = pos - modPos;
            vec2 stepPos = basePos;// hexRatio;
            st -= modPos;

            vec2 uv;
            vec2 huv;
            vec2 id;
            hexTile(st,uv,huv,id);

            id -= stepPos;// * vec2(1.,-1.);
            id += 1000.;

            vec2 screenCoord;
            screenCoord = st-uv;
            screenCoord += modPos;
            screenCoord *= rot(-angle * 0.0174533);
            screenCoord *= scale;
            screenCoord.x /= acLayerSize.x/acLayerSize.y;
            screenCoord += 0.5;
            screenCoord = l2s(screenCoord,acLayerToScreen);
            vec4 centerColor = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,screenCoord);

            float pp;
            if( alphaScale ) {
                pp = max(1. - centerColor.a, lineWidth);
            } else if (blendMode == 3) {
                pp = max(1. - step(0.001,centerColor.a), lineWidth);
            } else {
                pp = lineWidth;
            }
            //float p = smoothstep(pp,pp+(1.0-pp)*feather,huv.y);
            pp = ((pp-0.5) * (1.0+feather)) + 0.5;
            //pp *= 1.0 - feather;
            //pp += feather / 2.;
            float p = smoothstep(pp-feather/2.,pp+feather/2.,huv.y);

            vec4 color;
            if( colorMode == 0 ) {
                color = centerColor;
            } else if ( colorMode == 1 ) {
                color = color1;
                color.rgb *= color.a;
            } else if ( colorMode == 2 ) {
                float ys = step(1.73/2.,mod(id.y, 1.73));
                color = mix(color1,color2,ys);
                color.rgb *= color.a;
            } else if ( colorMode == 3 ) {
                float ys = step(1.73/2.,mod(id.y, 1.73));
                color = color1;
                color = mix(color,color2,step(0.33,mod(id.x + ys*1.66, 3.)));
                color = mix(color3,color,step(0.33,mod(id.x + 1.16 + ys*1.66, 3.)));
                color.rgb *= color.a;
            } else if ( colorMode == 4 ) {
                color = color1;
                color = mix(color,color3,smoothstep( PI*2./3. - ulp, PI*2./3. + ulp, huv.x + PI));
                color = mix(color,color2,smoothstep( PI/3. - ulp, PI/3. + ulp, huv.x));
                color.rgb *= color.a;
            } else if ( colorMode == 5 ) {
                float section = floor((huv.x + PI) * 3. / PI);
                if( section < 1. ) {
                    color = color1;
                } else if (section < 2. ) {
                    color = color2;
                } else if (section < 3. ) {
                    color = color1;
                } else if (section < 4. ) {
                    color = color3;
                } else if (section < 5. ) {
                    color = color1;
                } else {
                    color = color2;
                }
                color.rgb *= color.a;
            } else if ( colorMode == 6 ) {
                float section = floor((huv.x + PI) * 6. / PI);
                if( section < 1. ) {
                    color = color1;
                } else if (section < 5. ) {
                    color = color2;
                } else if (section < 9. ) {
                    color = color3;
                } else {
                    color = color1;
                }
                color.rgb *= color.a;
            //} else if ( colorMode == 7 ) {
            //    color = mix(color1,color2,(sin(id.x/2.0)+1.)/2.);
            }

            //vec4 c = color * p;

            color *= p;

            if( copyAlpha ) {
                color *= centerColor.a;
            }

            color *= alpha;

            vec4 result;
            if( blendMode==0 ) {                // normal
                color *= texColor.a;
                result = color + (texColor*(1.0-color.a));
            } else if( blendMode==1 ) {         // multiply
                vec4 c = color + vec4(1.)*(1.-color.a);
                result = vec4((texColor.rgb/texColor.a)*c.rgb,1.0) * texColor.a;
            } else if( blendMode==2 ) {         // screen
                result = vec4( 1.-((1.-(texColor.rgb/texColor.a))*(1.-color.rgb)),1.0) * texColor.a;
            } else if( blendMode==3 ) {         // overflow
                result = color;
            } else if( blendMode==4 ) {         // punchout
                result = texColor * (1.0-p);
            } else if( blendMode==5 ) {         // overlay
                vec3 top = color.rgb / color.a;
                vec3 bot = texColor.rgb / texColor.a;
                vec3 t = smoothstep(0.5,0.5,bot);
                vec3 r3 =
                        t * (1. - (1.-2.*(bot-0.5)) * (1.-top)) +
                        (1.-t) * ((2.*bot) * top);
                vec4 r4 = vec4(r3, 1.0) * color.a * texColor.a;
                result = texColor * (1.-r4.a) + r4;
            }

            gl_FragColor = result;

        }

    ]]></shader>

</effect>

<effect id="com.alightcreative.effects.hexrotate" compat="acScreenNorm-y" name="@am:string/effect_hexrotate_name" desc="@am:string/effect_hexrotate_desc" category="distort" tags="distort,geometric,raster" thumb="thumb/hexarray.webp">

    <shader type="fragment" precision="high"><![CDATA[

        const float PI = 3.14159;
        const float ulp = PI/240.;

        const vec2 hexRatio = vec2(1.0, 1.73);
        const vec2 hexRatioNorm = normalize(hexRatio);

        float hexDist(vec2 p) {
            return max(dot(abs(p), hexRatioNorm), abs(p.x));
        }

        void hexTile(vec2 st, thread vec2 &uv, thread vec2 &huv, thread vec2 &id) {
            vec2 grid = mod(st, hexRatio)-hexRatio/2.;

            uv = length(grid) < length(offsetGrid) ? grid : offsetGrid;
            huv = vec2(atan(uv.x, uv.y), (.5-hexDist(uv))*2.);
            id = vec2(st.x-uv.x, st.y-uv.y);
        }

        mat2 rot(float a) {
            float c = cos(a);
            float s = sin(a);
            return mat2(
                c, -s,
                s, c
            );
        }

        vec2 l2s( vec2 v, mat4 acLTS ) {
            return (vec4(v,0.,1.)*acLTS).xy;
        }

        float rand(vec2 co)
        {
            float a = 719.310;
            float b = 178.233;
            float c = 33758.5453;
            float dt= dot(co.xy ,vec2(a,b));
            float sn= mod(dt,3.14);
            return fract(sin(sn) * c);
        }

        void main() {
            vec4 texColor = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,acScreenNorm);
            vec2 st;
            if(screenSpace) {
                st = acScreenNorm;
                st -= 0.5;
                st.x *= acScreenSize.x/acScreenSize.y;
            } else {
                st = acLayerNorm;
                st -= 0.5;
                st.x *= acLayerSize.x/acLayerSize.y;
            }
            
            vec2 scale = vec2(size/100. * stretch.x, size/100. * stretch.y);
            vec2 pos = (position/500.) * vec2(1., -1.);

            st /= scale;

            st *= rot(angle * 0.0174533);

            pos *= rot(-angle * 0.0174533);

            vec2 modPos = mod(pos,hexRatio*2.);

            vec2 stepPos = basePos;// hexRatio;
            st -= modPos;

            vec2 uv;
            vec2 huv;

            hexTile(st,uv,huv,id);

            id -= stepPos;// * vec2(1.,-1.);

            vec2 hexCenterScreenCoord;
            hexCenterScreenCoord = st-uv;
            hexCenterScreenCoord += modPos;
            hexCenterScreenCoord *= rot(-angle * 0.0174533);
            hexCenterScreenCoord *= scale;
            hexCenterScreenCoord.x /= acLayerSize.x/acLayerSize.y;
            hexCenterScreenCoord += 0.5;
            hexCenterScreenCoord = l2s(hexCenterScreenCoord,acLayerToScreen);

            float randAngle = (0.5 - rand( vec2(id.x,id.y+1937.7249*(seed+0.01)) ))*2.0*6.28318;

            float adjWarpAngle = warpAngle*smoothstep(0.,1.,length(uv));
            vec2 dc = acScreenNorm - hexCenterScreenCoord;
            dc.x *= acScreenSize.x/acScreenSize.y;
            dc *= rot( ((rotate+adjWarpAngle) * 0.0174533) + (twirl/360.0 * randAngle) );
            dc.x /= acScreenSize.x/acScreenSize.y;
            vec2 sampCoord = hexCenterScreenCoord + dc;

            //float px = id.x;
            //float py = id.y;
            //float dx = rand(vec2(px,py+3937.7249*(seed+0.01)));
            //float dy = rand(vec2(px+328.7319+432.7249*(seed+0.01),py-971.382));
            //vec2 dv = (vec2(dx,dy) - 0.5)*2.0;

            //vec2 sampCoord = acScreenNorm+dv*strength;
            //sampCoord = abs(mod(sampCoord-1.0,2.0)-1.0);
            sampCoord = abs(mod(sampCoord-1.0,2.0)-1.0);
            vec4 sampColor = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,sampCoord);

            if( maskToLayer ) {
                sampColor *= texColor.a;
                gl_FragColor = texColor * (1.-sampColor.a) + sampColor;
            } else {
                gl_FragColor = sampColor;
            }

            //gl_FragColor = sampColor; // * texColor.a;

        }

<effect id="com.alightcreative.effects.hexshift" compat="acScreenNorm-y" name="@am:string/effect_hexshift_name" desc="@am:string/effect_hexshift_desc" category="distort" tags="distort,geometric,raster" thumb="thumb/hexarray.webp">

                st.x *= acScreenSize.x/acScreenSize.y;
            } else {
                st = acLayerNorm;
                st -= 0.5;
                st.x *= acLayerSize.x/acLayerSize.y;

            vec2 id;
            hexTile(st,uv,huv,id);

            id -= stepPos;// * vec2(1.,-1.);
            id += 1000.;

            float px = id.x;
            float py = id.y;
            float dx = rand(vec2(px,py+3937.7249*(seed+0.01)));
            float dy = rand(vec2(px+328.7319+432.7249*(seed+0.01),py-971.382));
            vec2 dv = (vec2(dx,dy) - 0.5)*2.0;
            dv.x *= acScreenSize.x/acScreenSize.y;

            vec2 sampCoord = acScreenNorm+dv*strength;
            sampCoord = abs(mod(sampCoord-1.0,2.0)-1.0);
            vec4 sampColor = texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,sampCoord);
            if( maskToLayer ) {
                sampColor *= texColor.a;
                gl_FragColor = texColor * (1.-sampColor.a) + sampColor;
            } else {
                gl_FragColor = sampColor;
            }

        }

    ]]></shader>

</effect>
